role.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Reserves and Accruals, Unearned Premiums Reserve
role.documentation: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from the unearned premiums reserve.

role.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Valuation Allowance

role.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Gross [Abstract]

role.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Goodwill

role.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Tax Deferred Income

role.negatedLabel: Pretax net loss recognized in Accumulated other comprehensive loss
role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Accumulated Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, before Tax

role.terseLabel: Actual return on plan assets, net of expenses
role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Increase (Decrease) for Actual Return (Loss)

role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, Actuarial Gain (Loss)
role.documentation: Amount of gain (loss) from change in actuarial assumptions which (increases) decreases benefit obligation of defined benefit plan. Assumptions include, but are not limited to, interest, mortality, employee turnover, salary, and temporary deviation from substantive plan.

role.terseLabel: Other changes in plan assets and projected benefit obligation recognized in other comprehensive income or loss:

role.label: Defined Benefit Plan Benefit Obligation Benefits Paid [Abstract]
role.documentation: Defined Benefit Plan Benefit Obligation Benefits Paid

role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Equity Securities, US [Member]

role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Funded (Unfunded) Status of Plan
role.documentation: Amount of funded (unfunded) status of defined benefit plan, measured as difference between fair value of plan assets and benefit obligation. Includes, but is not limited to, overfunded (underfunded) status.

role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Interest Cost
role.documentation: Amount of cost recognized for passage of time related to defined benefit plan.

role.terseLabel: Minimum eligibility age to participate in the plan

role.documentation: Represents the minimum age required to be attained by employees to participate in the plan.

role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Net Periodic Benefit Cost (Credit)
role.documentation: Amount of net periodic benefit cost (credit) for defined benefit plan.

role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Normal Retirement Age
role.documentation: Represents the normal retirement age for eligibility under the noncontributory defined benefit plan.

role.documentation: Amount of payment to participant under defined benefit plan which decreases plan assets. role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Actual Allocation, Percentage

role.documentation: Percentage of domestic federal statutory tax rate applicable to pretax income (loss).
